definitions.explanation: Deliberately extending the duration of something, often to avoid a decision or outcome. Usually carries a negative nuance of unnecessary delay.
Making something physically larger, especially enlarging a photograph or image.

examples.japanese: ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{引|ひ}き{延|の}ばし⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{許|ゆる}されない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧。
⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{引|ひ}き{延|の}ばし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{図|はか}っている→図る：12006_hakaru⟧ようだ。
examples.english: It seems like they're trying to buy time.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ{以上|いじょう}→これ以上：25431_koreijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{引|ひ}き{延|の}ばし⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{事態|じたい}→事態：10151_jitai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{悪化|あっか}させる→悪化する：18844_akkasuru⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧だ。

examples.japanese: {集合写真|しゅうごうしゃしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{延|の}ばしにして⟦{額|がく}→額：02607_gaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I had the group photo enlarged and framed.

notes:
The noun form of the compound verb {引|ひ}き{延|の}ばす (to stretch out / to enlarge). The two senses reflect the literal meaning of "stretching" applied in different domains — stretching time (stalling) and stretching an image (enlarging).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{引|ひ}き{延|の}ばし: stalling for time
- {引|ひ}き{延|の}ばし⟦{作戦|さくせん}→作戦：09673_sakusen⟧: a stalling tactic
- {引|ひ}き{延|の}ばし⟦{工作|こうさく}→工作：12437_kousaku⟧: a delaying maneuver
- ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{引|ひ}き{延|の}ばし: photo enlargement

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{先送|さきおく}り→先送り：08030_sakiokuri⟧: postponement; putting off — focusing on deferring to a later date
- ⟦{後回|あとまわ}し→後回し：07398_atomawashi⟧: putting off until later — similar to ⟦{先送|さきおく}り→先送り：08030_sakiokuri⟧ but more informal
- ⟦{延長|えんちょう}→延長：06447_enchou⟧: extension; prolongation — neutral term for making something longer; lacks the negative "stalling" nuance
- ⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧: enlargement; expansion — more commonly used for digital image scaling
